name: Remix Remix Global Hospital Information System (HIS) Staff Portal v2
description: Comprehensive Enterprise Hospital Information System (HIS) with Staff Portals for OPD Clinics, Emergency (ER), Inpatient Wards (IPD/ADT), Intensive Care (ICU), Operating Rooms (OR), Laboratory & Pathology (LIS), Radiology & Imaging (RIS), Pharmacy Operations, and Blood Bank & Transfusion Medicine Operations UX featuring pre-transfusion samples, forward/reverse ABO/Rh grouping, antibody screening, compatibility testing, unit allocation, ISBT-128 inventory, ready/issue handoff queues, returns disposition, MTP sessions, and hemovigilance transfusion reaction investigations.
